{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-cryx","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-q3hb: begin_unprotect_response updates replay window before buffer checks, preventing retry","description":"In `begin_unprotect_response` (lib.rs:1226-1228), `update_replay_window(seq)` is called immediately after successful decryption but BEFORE the buffer capacity checks for options (line 1250) and payload (line 1255). When a response decrypts successfully but the plaintext payload exceeds the 128-byte output buffer, `BufferTooSmall` is returned — but the replay window already consumed the responder PIV. This causes three test regressions:
1. `oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry` — valid retry with same PIV=0 gets Replay
2. `dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump` — re-protecting dropped current response gets Replay  
3. `delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window` — delayed response PIV=0x1_0000_0000 gets Replay

Additionally, when a `PendingResponse` is dropped without commit, the replay window update at line 1228 is never rolled back.

Fix: move `update_replay_window` call to `PendingResponse::commit()` (alongside `mark_received_response`), or defer it until after all post-decryption validation passes.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:08:42.954380968Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:08:42.954380968Z"}
